entities.summary: Richard Robinson Boon known as Dickie Boon was a Canadian ice hockey forward and manager. He played for the Montreal Hockey Club of the Canadian Amateur Hockey League (CAHL) and the Montreal Wanderers of the Federal Amateur Hockey League (FAHL) in the early 1900s. He was a player on two Stanley Cup winning teams and managed the Wanderers to four Cup titles. Boon was uncle to Lucille Wheeler-Vaughan, Canadian and world ski champion.
